headline: AGS Transact Technologies Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: AGS Transact Technologies Limited has been admitted into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), as intimated to BSE and NSE on 19 August 2026 following the 16th Committee of Creditors meeting.
implication: Listed company CIRP filings trigger mandatory exchange disclosure under Listing Rules; the CoC's formal recognition marks entry into statutory insolvency, initiating the 180-day (extendable) resolution window under IBC 2016 with priority creditor claims and asset recovery implications for stakeholders.
detail: AGS Transact Technologies Limited, a listed entity on NSE and BSE, has formally notified the exchanges of its admission into CIRP. The intimation references the 16th Committee of Creditors meeting, indicating the CoC has been constituted and is actively engaged in the insolvency process. The company's disclosure to the exchanges is mandated under SEBI Listing Regulations and marks the formal commencement of the statutory resolution timeline. No details of the triggering default, financial position, or resolution plan timeline have been disclosed in the available excerpt.
